name: deepx_attach_library_reference
description: Attach an official reference card (character portrait, previous scene video, or uploaded asset) from Google Flow's project library to the prompt box. Verifies that the photo card chip is visibly bound inside the ingredient bar before generation.

asset_name.description: Name of the character or library asset to attach (e.g. 'rohan_student', 'rohan_ca', or previous video title).
